Hey there! It's completely normal to encounter questions like this — let's dive into understanding it together.

items: You're asked to fetch teams in the top 4 positions that also have more than 65 points and 50 goals.
Chelsea has 68 points but only 45 goals (Position 3) — does not meet the goal requirement of >50.

blocks.content: Hence, Chelsea does not meet all the conditions, and that's why only 3 teams: United, City, and Arsenal appear in results.
Here's how the query should look to reflect these conditions:

SELECT team 
FROM EPL 
WHERE position <= 4 
  AND points > 65 
  AND goals > 50;

items: We applied filters for both points and goals while ensuring teams are in the top 4 positions.
Specifically checked each team against all conditions to understand results.
